description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Modification' class in the 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting' namespace. It provides methods for managing modifications within the OpenCart system, including adding, deleting, editing, and retrieving modifications from the database.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling CRUD operations related to modifications in the OpenCart admin setting module.

methods.name: addModification
methods.description: Inserts a new modification record into the database with the provided data.

methods.name: deleteModification
methods.description: Removes a modification from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteModificationsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Deletes all modifications associated with a specific extension installation ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific modification.

methods.name: getModification
methods.description: Retrieves a modification record by its ID.

methods.name: getModifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of modifications with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalModifications
methods.description: Returns the total number of modifications in the database.

methods.name: getModificationByCode
methods.description: Fetches a modification record by its unique code.
